ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white ground with a continuous black boundary along the leading and trailing edges. High-contrast dark circular spots are scattered across both lobes, with a significant irregular dark patch situated at the base of the fluke near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep axial penetration and an estimated pixel-calculated interior angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with high-amplitude variations. Notable deep rectangular-shaped indentations on the upper left lobe and multiple serrated 'saw-tooth' peaks on the upper right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex sweep; the left lobe shows a sharper upward trajectory toward the tip compared to the more rounded right lobe tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of roughly circular dark-grey pixels (approx. 12-15 focal points) distributed across the white surface, particularly concentrated in the medial region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible diagonally across the mid-section of the left lobe and lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural irregularities on the trailing edges consistent with tissue loss; specifically a large jagged notch on the distal upper left lobe and multiple deep serrations on the upper right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density 'dotted' pigmentation pattern across a predominantly white ventral field, combined with significant trailing edge trauma.
